title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.

definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.

providers.name: Google Workspace
providers.scope_notes: Context-Aware Access requires eligible Workspace/Cloud Identity editions. User policy coverage does not establish protection of DWD service accounts.

controls.name: Manage Domain Wide Delegation
controls.what: Super admins authorize each service account or OAuth client ID with an explicit scope list; editing scopes or deleting the client stops access.
controls.setting: Admin console > Security > Access and data control > API controls > Manage Domain Wide Delegation
controls.quote: add each scope that the application can access (should be appropriately narrow).

controls.name: Multi-party approval for domain-wide delegation
controls.what: When enabled, adding, editing or deleting a DWD client needs a second super admin's approval.
controls.quote: requires approval from another super admin.

controls.name: iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation / iam.managed.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation
controls.what: Org policy that blocks creation of user-managed service account keys used to sign DWD JWTs.
controls.quote: If your organization was created on or after May 3, 2024, this constraint is enforced by default.

controls.name: iam.disableServiceAccountKeyUpload
controls.what: Org policy that blocks uploading external public keys to service accounts.
controls.quote: When this constraint is set, users cannot upload public keys to service accounts in projects affected by the constraint.

controls.name: iam.serviceAccountKeyExpiryHours
controls.what: Org policy that sets a maximum lifetime for new service account keys, which otherwise never expire.
controls.quote: A service account key lets you authenticate a request as a service account. By default, service account keys never expire.

controls.name: iam.disableServiceAccountCreation
controls.what: Org policy that blocks creating new service accounts.
controls.setting: Google Cloud Organization Policy (constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountCreation or managed variant)
controls.quote: disable the creation of new service accounts

controls.name: Service account impersonation IAM (Service Account Token Creator)
controls.what: Only principals granted impersonation roles on the service account can mint tokens or sign JWTs as it.
controls.setting: Google Cloud IAM on the service account
controls.quote: Only authenticated principals with the appropriate permissions can impersonate service accounts.

authentication.summary: OAuth 2.0 user bearer tokens; service-account signed JWT exchange. Domain-wide delegation (DWD) enables approved user impersonation.

federation.details: Google documents WIF → service account → IAM signJwt → OAuth token for DWD. Workspace scopes/admin delegation remain separate requirements.

ip_restriction.boundary: Context-Aware Access offers user IP/device/location conditions. Its documentation explicitly excludes service-account API access.

renewal.summary: No refresh token; the app signs a new JWT (with a key, or keyless via IAM signJwt) and requests a new token. Key expiry depends on the org's key-expiry setting.

administration.summary: Approve/block third-party OAuth apps and scopes; restrict DWD scopes; control service-account IAM and key creation.
administration.conditions: Context-Aware Access requires eligible Workspace/Cloud Identity editions. User policy coverage does not establish protection of DWD service accounts.

sso.details: Context-Aware Access does not restrict Google API access from service accounts in general, but Drive policies do block automated tools from unauthorized IPs or devices.

offboard.details: A service account belongs to the application, not to an individual user.

inventory.details: Security > Access and data control > API controls > Manage Domain Wide Delegation lists every DWD client with its scopes.

sso.ui: Admin console > Security > Access and data control > Context-Aware Access > Assign access levels to apps > Drive (applies to automated tools; does not cover other Google APIs from service accounts)

reads.ui: Gmail log events (mail_event_type 33); Drive: Reporting > Audit and investigation > Drive log events, Event = Download, filter App ID = service account client ID

token_format.notes: Service account key is a JSON key file; GitHub scans google_cloud_service_account_credentials. Access tokens are opaque bearer tokens.

log_sources.name: Cloud Audit Logs (Data Access)
log_sources.notes: Service API use with serviceAccountKeyName; GenerateAccessToken impersonation logs need IAM Data Access logs enabled.

log_sources.notes: DWD calls into Workspace APIs; actor.applicationInfo.impersonation shows impersonation. 6 months.

lifecycle_events.notes: Short-lived token via impersonation (Data Access logs)

anomaly_cues: serviceAccountKeyName that does not match any key your deployment owns
AUTHORIZE_API_CLIENT_ACCESS adding Gmail/Drive scopes to a client ID

containment.steps: Delete or disable the key; remove the client ID from domain-wide delegation; disable the service account to stop issued short-lived credentials; review and remove IAM bindings.
containment.notes: Disabling a key does not revoke short-lived credentials already issued from it; disabling or deleting the service account does.

How DWD-impersonated calls appear in Workspace logs beyond actor.applicationInfo.impersonation

calls.call: POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token (grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer, signed JWT with sub=user)
calls.reveals: Exchanges service-account JWT (with sub impersonation) for an access token scoped to the impersonated user
calls.scope: scopes pre-authorized for the client ID in Workspace domain-wide delegation
calls.log_notes: Token minting at Google's token endpoint; not established to appear in Workspace admin audit logs as a distinct event

calls.reveals: All users in the domain (requires impersonating an admin); full directory roster
calls.log_event: OAuth Token audit log: activity event
calls.log_notes: API calls via the delegated token surface in token 'activity' events (client_id, api_name, method_name); Admin Console Admin audit may record directory reads separately

calls.reveals: Any impersonated user's mailbox messages; mass mailbox export across the domain
calls.log_event: Gmail audit mail_event_type 33; Token activity event
calls.log_notes: Gmail delivery event 33 'An application accessed a message on behalf of a user'; token 'activity' event logs the API call. Both via Admin SDK Reports.

calls.reveals: Impersonated user's Drive file list/metadata; precursor to bulk download
calls.log_notes: Drive audit 'download' event = 'Document download'; file metadata list itself may not fire a view/download event. Reports API / Workspace edition dependent.
